scope: One bundle per live node whose receipt is fresh under the §18 digest-freshness check (journal.kernel_digest equals the currently-deployed kernel source). Stale receipts are never bundled.
anchor_scope: The log half of every bundle here commits to the registry checkpoint ainumbers.co/registry/lineage (registry/lineage/checkpoint), not to the receipt itself (RECEIPT-BUNDLE.md §3.4). These bundles do not state that any receipt is transparency-logged.
